title: Business Etiquette and Protocol
overview: Initial impressions are frequently formed within the first seven seconds of a meeting and can be challenging, if not impossible, to alter. This course not only guides you in making a favorable first impression but also provides insights into interacting with others in a business context, considering cultural and regional differences. Given that business interactions often occur during meals, dining etiquette can significantly influence how others perceive you as a potential business ally. Throughout the course, you will receive guidance on applying appropriate manners and business etiquette in diverse settings
audience: Human resources personnel, public relations specialists, event organizers, personal assistants, individuals in the hospitality industry, and all those in positions that involve engaging and interacting with significant individuals in both government and private sectors.
methodology: This course is crafted to be interactive and participatory, incorporating diverse learning tools to empower participants to function efficiently. It is structured around four key learning pillars: concept learning (lectures and presentations), role-playing (group exercises), experience sharing (roundtable discussions), and exposure to real-world problems and policy choices encountered by delegates
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Guide on Correct Behavior in Business and Social Settings
Detail Effective Interaction and Communication with Diverse Guests
Exhibit Appropriate Personal and Professional Conduct
Organize VIP Visits and Formal Occasions while Excelling as a Host
Apply Varied Protocols and Etiquettes from Different Cultures, Nations, and Regions

outline.title: Foundations of Business Etiquette and Protocol
